verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Copilot provides both cloud and local sandboxes as isolated execution environments. These let the agent safely interact with code, tools, the filesystem, and network resources, which matches every element of the story. The evidence is a single summary-level claim, with no detail on how the isolation is configured or enforced. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of sandbox configuration and network isolation controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can have the agent operate inside a sandbox when interacting with code, tools, and network resources

citations.quote: Cloud and local sandboxes provide isolated execution environments that let Copilot safely interact with code, tools, filesystem, and network resources securely on your local machine or in fully isolated cloud environments.
